The Data Library includes donor details from ~3500 human pancreatic islet donors, biosamples and their corresponding raw and experimental data, and processed data derived from bioinformatics pipelines. Moreover, the library includes metadata, curated pipelines and workflows, and data and metadata standards. Toggle between listings of donors, assays, analyses, and processed results.
